verdict.rationale: Bento documents API keys: HTTP Basic auth with a publishable and secret key, MCP setup that takes your API keys, and Skills safety guidance about API keys. Nothing in the pack shows keys can be limited by permission, endpoint, or read/write scope for an agent. Site-level data isolation and key-handling guidance are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
